# R-501 Monomer Feed Phase: Control Narrative (Draft A)

Scope: ISA-88 phase `R501_MONOMER_FEED`, running on equipment module R-501. Numbers appear only in the parameter list (section 2.2). The prose refers to list items by ID.

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

| Item | Content |
|---|---|
| Function | Feed monomer to R-501 at the recipe rate until the recipe quantity is delivered. Hold temperature at the recipe setpoint. Stop feed if the reaction does not consume the monomer. |
| Upstream | Monomer supply (tag TBD) and the preceding recipe phase (initial charge and initiation, TBD). |
| Downstream | The next recipe phase (hold/cook), started on phase Complete. |
| Out of scope | SIS trip function (see SRS), alarm text and priorities (see alarm database), tuning values. |

## 2. Equipment and parameters

### 2.1 Tags (instrument index is the source)

| Tag | Role in phase |
|---|---|
| FIC-510 | Monomer feed flow control. Output valve tag TBD. |
| FQ-510 (assumed) | Feed totalizer. Confirm it exists. |
| TIC-505 | Reaction temperature (master) |
| TIC-506 | Jacket temperature (slave) |
| TV-506A / TV-506B | Cooling water / steam, split range |
| A-501 / SI-501 | Agitator / speed sensor |

### 2.2 Parameter list (single source for numbers)

| ID | Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| SL-01 | Feed rate (FIC-510 SP) | Recipe; typical 1.2 m³/h | Recipe |
| SL-02 | Feed quantity | Recipe | Recipe |
| SL-03 | Expected feed duration | About 4 h | Recipe, informational |
| SL-04 | TIC-505 SP | 80 °C | Recipe |
| SL-05 | Reaction high alarm | 88 °C | Alarm database |
| SL-06 | SIS high trip | 95 °C | SRS (reference only) |
| SL-07 | Minimum agitator speed | TBD | Process |
| SL-08 | Maximum allowed accumulation | TBD | Hazard review |
| SL-09 | Temperature deviation limit for feed permissive | TBD | Process |
| SL-10 | Initiation confirmation criterion and rate | TBD | Process |
| SL-11 | Feed ramp time | TBD | Process |
| SL-12 | Step timeouts (T1 to T4) | TBD | Process |
| SL-13 | Bad-PV and comms-loss debounce times | TBD | Controls |

## 3. States and transitions

Automation level: all transitions are automatic unless the table shows operator action.

| State | Entry permissives | Behavior | Allowed exits | Initiator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Idle | None | All phase outputs are off. | Running | Recipe or operator |
| Running | See FR-R501-001 | Feed and temperature control per section 5. | Holding, Stopping, Aborting, Complete | Auto or operator |
| Holding | None | FV-510 closes. Temperature control and A-501 continue. | Held, Aborting | Auto (fault) or operator |
| Held | None | Same as Holding. The phase waits. | Restarting, Stopping, Aborting | Operator |
| Restarting | Hold cause cleared, restart checks (FR-R501-012) | Re-verify conditions, then re-enter Running at the remaining quantity. | Running, Holding, Aborting | Operator |
| Stopping | None | FV-510 closes. Temperature control and A-501 continue. | Stopped | Operator |
| Stopped | None | Remaining quantity is kept. | Idle (after reset) | Operator |
| Aborting | None | FV-510 closes immediately. Cooling and agitation continue. | Aborted | Operator or auto |
| Aborted | None | Safe outputs held. | Idle (after reset) | Operator |
| Complete | Quantity reached (FQ-510 against SL-02) | Feed is closed. | Idle | Auto |

## 4. Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Test method (FAT) |
|---|---|---|
| FR-R501-001 | The phase shall start only if SI-501 is above SL-07, TIC-505 is in cascade, and TIC-505 is within SL-09 of SL-04. | Simulate each condition false. Confirm the start is refused. |
| FR-R501-002 | In Running, FIC-510 shall control feed flow to SL-01, ramped over SL-11. | Start the phase. Confirm the ramp and the final SP. |
| FR-R501-003 | The phase shall go to Complete when the FQ-510 total reaches SL-02. FV-510 shall close. | Simulate the total. Confirm the transition. |
| FR-R501-004 | During feed, TIC-505 shall hold SL-04 by cascade to TIC-506 and split range of TV-506A/B. | Step the PV. Confirm the cascade and the split-range response. |
| FR-R501-005 | The phase shall confirm initiation (SL-10) before it raises feed above the initial rate. If initiation is not confirmed within T1, the phase shall go to Holding. | Simulate no exotherm. Confirm the hold at T1. |
| FR-R501-006 | The phase shall calculate monomer accumulation continuously. Method is an open item (OI-01). | Simulate low consumption. Confirm Holding at SL-08. |
| FR-R501-007 | If accumulation exceeds SL-08, the phase shall go to Holding. FV-510 shall close. | As FR-R501-006 |
| FR-R501-008 | If SI-501 falls below SL-07, the phase shall go to Holding. | Simulate low speed. Confirm Holding. |
| FR-R501-009 | In Holding, Held, Stopping, Aborting, and Aborted, FV-510 shall be closed and TIC-505 shall stay in control. A-501 shall stay on. | Command each state. Confirm the outputs. |
| FR-R501-010 | A bad TIC-505 or FIC-510 PV (after SL-13) shall cause Holding. | Force bad quality. Confirm Holding. |
| FR-R501-011 | A bad TIC-506 PV shall cause Holding. The phase shall tell the operator to take manual cooling control. | Force bad quality. Confirm Holding and the prompt. |
| FR-R501-012 | Restart shall re-check FR-R501-001, FR-R501-005, and FR-R501-006 before feed resumes. Restart shall use the remaining quantity (SL-02 minus FQ-510). | Hold, clear the cause, restart. Confirm the checks and the quantity. |
| FR-R501-013 | After controller power loss or restart, the phase shall not resume feed automatically. It shall go to Aborted or Held (OI-03). | Cycle power. Confirm FV-510 stays closed. |
| FR-R501-014 | Loss of communication between controller and I/O or HMI shall be handled per the abnormal-handling table (section 7). | Simulate the loss. Confirm the response. |
| FR-R501-015 | The phase shall not depend on, and shall not override, the SIS trip (SL-06). The SIS function is in the SRS. | Review against the SRS. |

Interlocks and permissives: see the cause-and-effect chart for R-501. Alarms: see the alarm database. The reaction high alarm (SL-05) is defined there.

## 5. Regulatory control

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Cascade/override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FIC-510 | Feed flow | FV-510 | Reverse | Auto in Running. Output forced closed in all non-Running states. | Setpoint from recipe through the ramp |
| TIC-505 | Reaction temperature | TIC-506 SP | Reverse | Cascade in Running | Master of TIC-506 |
| TIC-506 | Jacket temperature | Split range to TV-506A/B | Reverse | Cascade, with manual fallback | Slave of TIC-505. Confirm anti-windup on feed stop. |

Split range: TV-506A (cooling water) and TV-506B (steam) share one output. The range split goes in the software design spec.

## 6. Sequence (Running)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check start permissives. | FR-R501-001 true | T1 | Phase does not start. Prompt the operator. |
| 2 | Put TIC-505 in cascade if it is not. | TIC-505 in cascade | T2 | Holding |
| 3 | Open FV-510 and ramp FIC-510 to the initial feed rate. | Flow stable | T3 | Holding |
| 4 | Confirm initiation (SL-10). | Exotherm detected | T1 | Holding. Do not increase feed. |
| 5 | Ramp FIC-510 to SL-01. Monitor accumulation. | SL-01 reached | T4 | Holding |
| 6 | Feed until FQ-510 reaches SL-02. | Quantity reached | None. Run time is limited by the accumulation check. | Not applicable |
| 7 | Close FV-510 and set FIC-510 to manual with zero output. | FV-510 closed | T3 | Alert operator. Go to Holding. |
| 8 | Report Complete. | None | None | Not applicable |

Confirm whether the initial feed rate and T1 belong to the recipe or the phase (OI-02).

## 7. Abnormal handling

| Condition | Phase response | Operator action |
|---|---|---|
| Bad TIC-505 or FIC-510 PV | Holding (FR-R501-010) | Fix the instrument. Restart. |
| Bad TIC-506 PV | Holding (FR-R501-011) | Control cooling manually. |
| Agitator speed low | Holding (FR-R501-008) | Restore A-501. Restart. |
| Controller to I/O comms loss | Outputs go to the configured fail state (OI-04). FV-510 shall close. | Check the network. |
| HMI comms loss | The phase continues. The operator cannot act. Hold on timeout (OI-04). | Restore the HMI. |
| Power loss and restart | No auto resume (FR-R501-013) | Check the batch status. Decide on restart or abort. |
| Fail positions | FV-510 fail closed. TV-506A fail open. TV-506B fail closed. These are assumptions. | Confirm in OI-05. |

If the temperature rises, the alarm at SL-05 alerts the operator. The SIS acts at SL-06. The phase makes no trip decision.

## 8. Operator interface

- Faceplate displays phase state, feed rate, FQ-510 total, remaining quantity, TIC-505, TIC-506, SI-501, and the accumulation value with its limit.
- Operator commands: Start, Hold, Restart, Stop, Abort, Reset.
- The phase prompts for the cause of a hold, for manual cooling control, and for restart after a hold. Operations must sign off on states and prompts.

## 9. Open items

| ID | Item | Owner | Date |
|---|---|---|---|
| OI-01 | Choose the accumulation calculation (for example a heat balance from jacket duty against fed monomer, or a temperature response check). Set SL-08. Confirm that jacket flow and inlet/outlet temperature instruments exist. | Process and hazard review lead | TBD at review |
| OI-02 | Decide which parameters belong to the recipe and which to the phase. | Process | TBD |
| OI-03 | Choose Aborted or Held after power restart. | Operations and controls | TBD |
| OI-04 | Define comms-loss fail states and timeouts. | Controls | TBD |
| OI-05 | Confirm valve fail positions and the FV-510 tag. | Instrument engineer | TBD |
| OI-06 | Confirm which hazard-review items need SIS coverage. Examples: loss of agitation, or accumulation as a safety function. | Hazard review lead | TBD |
| OI-07 | Fill the TBD values in the parameter list. | Process | TBD |

OI-06 matters because accumulation limiting is a hazard-review requirement. If the review assigns a risk reduction to it, an SIS function is needed, and a BPCS phase check alone is not enough. That function belongs in the SRS.

## 10. Check status

- Numbers are in the parameter list only. The prose uses IDs.
- Every requirement has an ID and a test method.
- Every sequence step has a timeout and failure response. The timeout values are TBD.
- Not yet done: the STE editing pass, and the owner dates in the open items.
- The values marked TBD, the assumed FQ-510 totalizer, and the assumed fail positions need your input before the draft is issued for review.
